ambient_events: A cell door stands open on a made bed nobody has slept in.
Somebody writes a first name in the ledger and does not write a surname.
The fire is fed one log and left alone.
A jug is taken away full and brought back full.
Wind comes down the hall from the propped door and nobody moves to shut it.
description:
A hall with six cells off it, each with a bed made up, a stool, a shelf and a jug. Nothing in any of them belongs to anybody. A ledger lies open on a stand by the door and a pen beside it, and the ledger is a list of first names and dates and nothing else, going back years, in a dozen hands.

At the far end there is a fire lit and a chair pulled up to it, and neither is for anyone in particular.
name: The Open Door
